lead_fa: بازی Fury Warrior تند و پیوسته است: فقط یک خرج‌کنندهٔ [[Rage]] داری به نام [[Rampage]] و هدف روتیشن تولید رِیج کافی و حفظ دائمی [[Enrage]] است؛ بقیهٔ دکمه‌ها ([[Bloodthirst]]، [[Raging Blow]]، [[Execute]] و پرکننده‌ها) کول‌داون کوتاه یا صفر دارند و هیچ وقفه‌ای در کار نیست. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Mountain Thane]] با [[Thunder Clap]] و آذرخش‌ها و [[Slayer]] که [[Execute]] و [[Bladestorm]] را پرتکرارتر می‌کند؛ برچسب Best منبع مال سلیر است.

strengths: Excels at dynamically swapping between single-target and multi-target
Strong burst mobility and gap closers
Good personal defensive abilities and a raid-wide defensive cooldown
weaknesses: Very susceptible to downtime due to the lack of ranged attacks or passive resource generation
Flat damage profile is less suited toward burst phases or very short encounters
Minimum range restrictions and cooldowns can limit mobility in bad situations
Gimmicky cheat death is not viable in most PvE content

buffs: Rend re-added as a new ability: applied passively by Whirlwind and Thunder Clap
Hack and Slash resets now provide a large bonus to Raging Blow
nerfs: Removed abilities: Onslaught, Ravager, Bitter Immunity and Thunderous Roar
changes_12_1.note: Fury underwent several major talent changes in Midnight, including the removal of some active abilities.

hero.recommendation: Slayer carries the Best tags for Single Target, Raid Multitarget and Mythic+ Dungeons; Mountain Thane is the alternative. Mountain Thane harnesses the storm, calling down Lightning Strikes and reintroducing Thunder Clap to Fury: Crashing Thunder turns it into a hard-hitting Rage generator taking Whirlwind's place in the rotation, combined with Burst of Power and the potential of Thunder Blast. Slayer greatly enhances Execute and the re-added Bladestorm with mobility enhancements to Charge and Heroic Leap and interrupt/stun while channeling Bladestorm, though it lacks compelling defensive benefits.
hero.mountain_thane: Calls down Lightning Strikes and reintroduces Thunder Clap via Crashing Thunder as a Rage generator replacing Whirlwind, with Burst of Power and the stronger Thunder Blast.
hero.slayer: Greatly enhances Execute and the re-added Bladestorm, causing both to be used very frequently and deal significantly increased damage; Charge and Heroic Leap enhancements plus interrupt and stun while channeling Bladestorm.

concepts: Avoid downtime: Fury generates the majority of its Rage from abilities, so minimize time spent chasing targets or running mechanics; use Charge and Heroic Leap smartly

Keep abilities on cooldown: nearly every rotational ability generates Rage while only Rampage spends it in large amounts; keep abilities flowing so Enrage never drops, even delaying Rampage to spend Rage more efficiently
Avoid wasting Rage: Rage starts from zero and decays out of combat; spend efficiently to maintain the rotation
Maximize Enrage uptime and deal damage through fast-paced attacks; excels at high multi-target damage while sacrificing little to no single-target performance
st_during_cooldowns: Cast Rampage as much as possible immediately before using Bladestorm
Cast Rampage if Hack and Slash is not active
st_outside_cooldowns: Cast Rampage over 100 rage or if Enrage is about to expire
Cast Whirlwind when nothing else is available
aoe_during_cooldowns: Cast Whirlwind if the Whirlwind buff is not active
Cast Rampage as much as possible
aoe_outside_cooldowns: Cast Whirlwind if the Whirlwind buff is not active
Cast Rampage as much as possible
rotation.aoe_note: Improved Whirlwind lets Fury cleave its normal single-target rotation to 4 additional targets, fitting naturally into the rotation for very easy cleave damage.

cooldowns.Recklessness: Increases rage generation for much more regular Rampage use, further enhanced by the apex talent Rampaging Berserker; its cooldown is reduced by Anger Management and it aligns perfectly with Avatar for high uptime over a dungeon or encounter
cooldowns.Avatar: Major burst cooldown aligned with Recklessness via Anger Management
cooldowns.Bladestorm: Re-added and greatly enhanced by Slayer, used very frequently
cooldowns.Odyn's Fury: Major listed cooldown, used before opening cooldowns in the opener to avoid cluttering the rotation
cooldowns.Champion's Spear: Major listed cooldown in the rotation
cooldowns.Thunder Blast: High priority during Avatar for Mountain Thane

rotation.hero_notes: Unhinged automatically applies one of the Recklessness buffs for Slayer, leaving Mountain Thane to do both manually during each cooldown cycle. Because Thunder Blast has a high priority during Avatar there is no need to preemptively apply the Whirlwind buff. Recklessness and Avatar are both affected by Anger Management and can be macroed together. Execute timing varies with Sudden Death procs; Storm Bolt during Bladestorm is an extremely minor damage increase and not worth a talent. Whirlwind can be cast mid-charge to trigger its buff before going in, and cooldowns should be saved for additional targets coming up soon after the pull.
opener: The Fury opener is virtually identical to its single-target priority with the main goal of triggering Enrage as soon as possible; pre-cast Recklessness where possible
pre_combat: Apply weapon oils and use the augment rune as needed

gear.gearing_rules: Both Mountain Thane and Slayer emphasize weapon damage and Strength (via item level) along with Haste and Mastery; secondary stats fluctuate heavily with gear level since heavily stacked stats drop past diminishing returns. The choice between Frenzied Enrage and Powerful Enrage affects long-term stat value. Sim with Raidbots.

mplus.hero_note: Slayer carries the Best tag for Mythic+ Dungeons this season: frequent Executes with Sudden Death and a very frequent Bladestorm fit the dungeon pacing, while Improved Whirlwind cleaves the rotation to 4 extra targets almost for free.
tips: Keep the Whirlwind buff up for the cleave; it is the glue of the AoE rotation
Cast Rampage as much as possible to keep Enrage alive even during movement segments
Macro Recklessness with Avatar (both run on Anger Management) and save them for big pulls
Use Odyn's Fury before opening cooldowns so the rotation stays clean
Whirlwind mid-charge to trigger its buff on arrival
